ops.text: Aggregate Cap. Except for the matters described in clauses (A) through (D) of Section 11.5 and for a Party's breach of its data protection or security obligations or its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights, for which liability is not capped, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim by AbbVie under this Agreement and (b) USD 1,000,000. Customer's payment obligations under this Agreement, and all amounts due, are not damages for purposes of the foregoing cap.

input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement waives indirect and consequential damages but has no aggregate cap, so both Parties carry unlimited direct exposure; we add a mutual cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000. The existing clause (A)-(D) carve-outs stay uncapped, as do data protection and security breaches and infringement of the other Party's IP, and Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
input.summary: Insert a mutual aggregate liability cap (greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000) with the existing and added carve-outs uncapped.
